title: Uranium Royalty: The Right Model for an Outbreaking Uranium Market
summary: Uranium Royalty Corp. is a pure-play uranium royalty company focused on gaining exposure to uranium prices by making strategic investments in uranium interests, including royalties, streams, debt and equity investments in uranium companies, as well as through holdings of physical uranium. The Company's strategy recognizes the inherent cyclicality of valuations based on uranium prices, including the impact of such cyclicality on the availability of capital within the uranium sector and the current historically low uranium pricing environment.
body_markdown:
## Uranium Royalty: The Right Model for an Outbreaking Uranium Market


September 20, 2021


An interview with President & CEO Scott Melbye with Swiss Resource Capital. The breakout of the uranium price above $50 drove up all uranium stocks, particularly benefiting Uranium Royalty, which can also acquire physical uranium through its strategic partnership with Yellow Cake. Uranium Royalty already owns several royalty deals, particularly in the world's best uranium district, the Athabasca Basin. This puts the company in an excellent position for a further uranium price increase, which is only a matter of time.
